Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.integration.directory

Class KfeKeroseneNodeDirectory

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.integration.directory.KfeKeroseneNodeDirectory
@Component @ConditionalOnProperty(name="kfe.kerosene-node.enabled", havingValue="true") public final class KfeKeroseneNodeDirectory extends Object
Fail-closed authorization bridge from KFE to a Vault-plane Kerosene Node.

The Node manifest signs the member onion host at the discovery port. KFE keeps using its existing Tor+mTLS Vault transport, but refuses every configured Vault URL whose onion host is absent from the verified manifest.

  • Constructor Details

    • KfeKeroseneNodeDirectory

      @Autowired public KfeKeroseneNodeDirectory(org.springframework.boot.web.client.RestTemplateBuilder builder, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper objectMapper, @Value("${kfe.kerosene-node.base-url}") String baseUrl, @Value("${kfe.kerosene-node.fallback-urls:}") String fallbackUrls, @Value("${kfe.kerosene-node.network-id}") String expectedNetwork, @Value("${kfe.kerosene-node.tls.cert-path}") String certPath, @Value("${kfe.kerosene-node.tls.key-path}") String keyPath, @Value("${kfe.kerosene-node.tls.ca-path}") String caPath, @Value("${kfe.kerosene-node.transport:tor}") String transport, @Value("${kfe.kerosene-node.proxy.socks-host:}") String socksHost, @Value("${kfe.kerosene-node.proxy.socks-port:9050}") int socksPort, @Value("${kfe.kerosene-node.cache-ttl-ms:15000}") long cacheTtlMs, @Value("${kfe.kerosene-node.connect-timeout-ms:10000}") int connectTimeoutMs, @Value("${kfe.kerosene-node.read-timeout-ms:20000}") int readTimeoutMs)
      Builds the authenticated node client, validating TLS material, transport, base URL and cache policy. The roster cache is clamped to at least one second; each refresh checks quorum before fetching a manifest and fails closed if its network, plane, or member list is invalid.
      Parameters:
      builder - Spring client builder used to apply timeout and request-factory settings
      objectMapper - JSON parser for the membership response
      baseUrl - HTTPS onion base URL of the Kerosene Node
      fallbackUrls - explicitly configured alternative HTTPS onion seeds
      expectedNetwork - network ID that must match the manifest
      certPath - client certificate path for mutual TLS
      keyPath - client private key path for mutual TLS
      caPath - trusted certificate authority path
      transport - configured onion transport mode
      socksHost - SOCKS proxy hostname when required by the selected transport
      socksPort - SOCKS proxy port
      cacheTtlMs - roster cache lifetime in milliseconds, clamped to at least 1,000
      connectTimeoutMs - connection timeout in milliseconds
      readTimeoutMs - response-read timeout in milliseconds

    • requireAuthorized

      public void requireAuthorized(Collection<String> vaultUrls)
      Rejects any configured Vault endpoint absent from the latest verified node membership roster. A fresh roster is fetched only after the cache expires.
      Parameters:
      vaultUrls - Vault transport URLs whose onion hosts must be authorized
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if membership cannot be verified or any host is not authorized
